description_target.target_text: Normalize every motif to its frame-relative local coordinates and identify the unique candidate whose local pattern differs from the rest. Output a strip marking that odd candidate.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (uv< a b)
      (if (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)) (< (first a) (first b))))
    (define (point< a b)
      (cond [(not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b))]
            [(not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b))]
            [else (< (third a) (third b))]))
    (define (make-frame origin vx vy colors) (list origin vx vy colors))
    (define (frame-origin f) (first f))
    (define (frame-vx f) (second f))
    (define (frame-vy f) (third f))
    (define (frame-colors f) (fourth f))
    (define (frame< a b)
      (let ((oa (frame-origin a)) (ob (frame-origin b))
            (vxa (frame-vx a)) (vxb (frame-vx b))
            (vya (frame-vy a)) (vyb (frame-vy b)))
        (cond [(not (= (first oa) (first ob))) (< (first oa) (first ob))]
              [(not (= (second oa) (second ob))) (< (second oa) (second ob))]
              [(not (= (first vxa) (first vxb))) (< (first vxa) (first vxb))]
              [(not (= (second vxa) (second vxb))) (< (second vxa) (second vxb))]
              [(not (= (first vya) (first vyb))) (< (first vya) (first vyb))]
              [else (< (second vya) (second vyb))])))
    (define (gpos frame u v)
      (let* ((origin (frame-origin frame))
             (vx (frame-vx frame))
             (vy (frame-vy frame)))
        (list (+ (first origin) (* u (first vx)) (* v (first vy)))
              (+ (second origin) (* u (second vx)) (* v (second vy))))))
    (define (lpos frame p)
      (let* ((origin (frame-origin frame))
             (dr (- (first p) (first origin)))
             (dc (- (second p) (second origin)))
             (vx (frame-vx frame))
             (vy (frame-vy frame)))
        (list (+ (* dr (first vx)) (* dc (second vx)))
              (+ (* dr (first vy)) (* dc (second vy))))))
    (define (find-frames grid colors)
      (let* ((a (first colors)) (b (second colors)) (c (third colors))
             (raw
              (filter values
                      (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows grid))]
                                   [col (in-range (cols grid))]
                                   [dx (in-list cardinal-deltas)]
                                   [dy (in-list cardinal-deltas)])
                        (let* ((xr (+ r (first dx))) (xc (+ col (second dx)))
                               (yr (+ r (first dy))) (yc (+ col (second dy))))
                          (if (and (= (at grid r col) a)
                                   (in-bounds? xr xc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                   (in-bounds? yr yc (rows grid) (cols grid))
                                   (= (at grid xr xc) b)
                                   (= (at grid yr yc) c)
                                   (= (+ (* (first dx) (first dy)) (* (second dx) (second dy))) 0))
                              (make-frame (list r col) dx dy colors)
                              #f))))))
        (sort (remove-duplicates raw) frame<)))
    (define (extract-local-points grid frame colors radius)
      (let ((rad (min radius 3)))
        (sort
         (filter values
                 (for*/list ([r (in-range (rows grid))]
                              [c (in-range (cols grid))])
                   (let ((v (at grid r c)))
                     (if (member? v colors)
                         (let ((uv (lpos frame (list r c))))
                           (if (<= (max (abs (first uv)) (abs (second uv))) rad)
                               (list (first uv) (second uv) v)
                               #f))
                         #f))))
         point<)))
    (define (point-uv p) (list (first p) (second p)))
    (define (point-color p) (third p))
    (define (point-uvs points) (map point-uv points))
    (define (canonical-uvs uvs) (sort uvs uv<))
    (define (canonical-points points) (sort points point<))
    (define (local-bbox uvs)
      (let ((us (map first uvs)) (vs (map second uvs)))
        (list (apply min us) (apply min vs) (apply max us) (apply max vs))))
    (define (bbox-fill-points uvs color)
      (let* ((bb (local-bbox uvs))
             (u0 (first bb)) (v0 (second bb)) (u1 (third bb)) (v1 (fourth bb)))
        (for*/list ([u (in-range u0 (+ u1 1))]
                    [v (in-range v0 (+ v1 1))])
          (list u v color))))
    (define (bbox-boundary-points uvs color)
      (let* ((bb (local-bbox uvs))
             (u0 (first bb)) (v0 (second bb)) (u1 (third bb)) (v1 (fourth bb)))
        (filter values
                (for*/list ([u (in-range u0 (+ u1 1))]
                             [v (in-range v0 (+ v1 1))])
                  (if (or (= u u0) (= u u1) (= v v0) (= v v1))
                      (list u v color)
                      #f)))))
    (define (paint-local-points grid frame points)
      (for/fold ([out grid]) ([p (in-list points)])
        (let ((rc (gpos frame (first p) (second p))))
          (set-cell out (first rc) (second rc) (point-color p)))))
    (define (qcounts uvs)
      (list
       (count-where (lambda (uv) (and (> (first uv) 0) (> (second uv) 0))) uvs)
       (count-where (lambda (uv) (and (< (first uv) 0) (> (second uv) 0))) uvs)
       (count-where (lambda (uv) (and (< (first uv) 0) (< (second uv) 0))) uvs)
       (count-where (lambda (uv) (and (> (first uv) 0) (< (second uv) 0))) uvs)))
    (define (manhattan-radius uv) (+ (abs (first uv)) (abs (second uv))))
    (define (uv-rot90 uv) (list (- (second uv)) (first uv)))
    (define (uv-refl-diag uv) (list (second uv) (first uv)))
    (define (rot90-points points)
      (map (lambda (p)
             (let ((uv (uv-rot90 (point-uv p))))
               (list (first uv) (second uv) (point-color p))))
           points))
    (define (refl-diag-points points)
      (map (lambda (p)
             (let ((uv (uv-refl-diag (point-uv p))))
               (list (first uv) (second uv) (point-color p))))
           points))
    (define (frame-signature frame) (list (frame-vx frame) (frame-vy frame)))
    (define canon-e7 (list (list 2 0) (list 0 2) (list 1 1) (list 2 2)))

    (let* ((candidates (find-frames g (list 5 6 7)))
           (sigs (map (lambda (tf)
                        (canonical-uvs (point-uvs (extract-local-points g tf (list 8) 4))))
                      candidates))
           (idxs (range 0 (length candidates)))
           (odd (first (filter (lambda (i)
                                 (= (count-where (lambda (sig) (equal? sig (list-ref sigs i))) sigs) 1))
                               idxs))))
      (grid-from-fn 1 (length candidates) (lambda (r c) (if (= c odd) 8 0))))
  ))
